name: Recovery Request to Code Sent
summary: The anonymous user submits an email address, the server processes a non-enumerating password-recovery request, and the client shows the same recovery-code entry state whether or not the account exists.

preconditions.expression: session-capability == anonymous and auth.password.reset.request is visible

inputs.name: Email
inputs.description: Email address supplied for password recovery; the public result must not disclose whether an account exists.

serverInteraction.intent: Request password-recovery code delivery while returning the same public success and next user-visible state for known and unknown accounts.

postconditions.expression: session-capability == anonymous and auth.password.reset.sent is visible and account existence remains undisclosed

sourceReferences.note: SendResetPasswordLinkAsync now creates and emails a six-digit recovery code for known accounts and returns the same public success for unknown accounts.
Shared request-stage scenario for Success and Rejected; known-account and unknown-account handling are runtime permutations beneath the same canonical public outcome.
